name: Y2K Aesthetic
summary: Chrome and translucent plastic, bubble shapes, silver and electric blue, and small pixel and tech type on cold gradients. It came from the dot-com boom and the first iMac in 1998, and it pictured the year 2000 as a clean, shiny future.

philosophy.core_thesis: Technology is friendly and the future is shiny, so an interface should look like a new gadget that is already finished.
design_principles: Fill large areas with vertical or radial gradients that run from a pale tint to a saturated hue, over a 40% to 60% lightness range.
Make buttons and badges as glossy pills with a radius of 999px and a white highlight that covers the upper 45% of the shape.
Use translucent plastic panels at 55% to 80% opacity with a 1px white inner highlight and a coloured tint.
Place chrome, globe, orbit and star motifs behind the content, at 15% to 40% of the viewport width.
Pair a wide rounded display face with a small 10px to 12px tech sans or pixel face for labels and metadata.
Build the palette from silver, ice blue and one electric accent, and add one acid hue for warnings and tags.
Add small functional detail: serial numbers, version tags, tiny arrows and 1px dividers in a light grey.
anti_patterns: Matte flat fills with no gradient
Torn paper, grain and photocopy texture
Square corners on buttons and badges
Serif body text with a literary tone
Heavy black outlines and hard offset shadows
Hand-drawn scribbles and rough ink edges

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid at 960px or 1024px maximum width with 16px gutters; modules sit in table-like rows, and a floating hero object breaks the grid by up to 80px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 35% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16, 32, 64px, with tight gaps of 4px inside component groups.
layout.alignment_rules: Centre the hero and the logo, flush-left the navigation and body text, and stack components in a symmetrical column with the main object on the central axis.
layout.container_geometry: Pills and capsules with 999px radius for controls, panels with a 16px to 24px radius, and orbs or circles at 48px to 240px for hero shapes.

font_pairings.note: Wide squared capitals with a smooth technical text face.
Rounded wide display with a friendly body.
Extended display capitals with rounded body forms.
A pixel face for tags only, over a neutral grotesque text.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take +0.04em to +0.12em in upper case; body stays at 0; 10px labels take +0.1em.
hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 700, with display in upper case at 32px to 64px.
Set labels and metadata in 10px to 12px upper case with +0.1em tracking.
Give the display text a vertical gradient fill from white to ice blue or a 1px dark edge, and never a flat grey.
Keep body copy at 14px to 16px in dark navy on a light panel.

color.palette_structure: Silver and ice blue cover 60% of the surface; one electric blue or cyan covers 25%; one acid accent in lime or hot pink covers under 5%.
color.contrast_rules: Body text in navy holds 12:1 or better on ice and silver panels; white text on electric blue holds 4.5:1 and appears at 14px bold or larger only.
color.surface_treatment: Glossy and translucent: vertical gradients, a white specular band over the top 45% and tinted plastic panels at 55% to 80% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: Light comes from the top, with a white highlight at the top edge and a soft coloured shadow below; add a cyan outer glow of 12px to 24px on active elements.

materiality.surface_simulation: Translucent coloured plastic and brushed chrome, as on the 1998 iMac G3 and brushed metal gadgets.
materiality.border_rules: 1px borders in a lighter tint of the fill, with a 1px white inner highlight; metal edges use a 2px light-to-dark gradient.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Soft shadows with 8px to 24px blur and a 4px to 8px vertical offset at 25% opacity; background blur is rare and stays under 8px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Glossy 3D-like icons at 32px to 48px with a 1px outline, a top highlight and a reflection; small pixel arrows at 12px.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Chrome blobs, globes, orbit rings, stars and lens flares drawn as smooth vector or 3D renders; figures are simple, shiny and faceless.

motion.transition_physics: Smooth, springy and slightly floaty: objects glide in, overshoot by 4% to 8% and settle; glows pulse slowly and Flash-style tweens loop.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the gloss band to 55% opacity and adds a 16px cyan glow; active presses the button by 1px and darkens the gradient by 10%.

emotion.target_response: Excited optimism: the viewer feels that the product is new, fast and part of a bright digital future.

avoid_when: The brand needs a serious, quiet or handmade tone.
The interface is dense data work where gloss and glow slow the eye.
The product must follow a current flat platform design system.

modifiers.how: Add sky, grass and water imagery, soften the chrome to a 20px glass radius and move the palette to green and aqua; keep the gloss and the rounded type.
Remove the gradients, highlights and glows, keep two hues and the pill shapes at a 12px radius.
Raise background blur to 16px to 24px, lower panel opacity to 20% to 40% and drop the chrome; keep the cool palette.
Use a 12-column grid, one sans serif and one blue accent; keep the small upper-case labels.

pack.why: Pixel-grid forms: the screen technology of the period shows in the icon.
